name: striking-tides-on-hit-no-floating-memory-card-no-prompt
notes: Striking Tides (qrxQGA1pc6): the On Hit only offers cards with floating memory. The champion is Mordred, Burnished Avenger (level 1: attack cards do NOT float) and the graveyard holds only a Dungeon Guide: no prompt appears, nothing is banished and the champion stays rested.

rulesClauses: On Hit offers only cards WITH floating memory: with none in the graveyard nothing happens.
